people.name: Hushim
people.line: Son of Dan, ancestor of the Shuhamites.

translations.web: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
translations.bsb: All of them were Shuhamite clans, and their registration numbered 64,400.
translations.kjv: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
translations.asv: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
